**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Miss Yonge,
We will give you the [£200](../others.html#160) for the copyright of the [Cameos](../books.html#73).

It is a rather full sum but the book is of a kind we like to possess.

Some day we will get a series of actual Cameos engraved for it.

But in the mean time we contract [illegible] with [one for the title page](../others.html#167) & one for the cover. [I ](../persons.html#939)think you will certainly like the look of the book.

We send the '[Pupils](../books.html#72)' & '[Golden deeds](../books.html#51)' to [Mrs Montgomery Moore](../persons.html#1042) by today’s post.

With kind regards
Yours very faithfully
A.

Macmillan
